capabilities: Sync a vault across desktop and mobile with end-to-end encryption
Merge conflicting edits automatically or keep conflict copies
Recover deleted files and older versions from file history and trash
Connect new devices via QR code, one-time codes or a recovery phrase
Manage account, devices, sign-ins and storage use in settings
disambiguation: Not the self-hosted selfsync plugin; this one syncs through the hosted Selfsync Cloud service and requires an account.
extras: Status is early release and the plugin is distributed via GitHub Releases, not yet in the community directory; all accounts are currently on the free plan and larger plans will be paid. The README warns that losing every device without a written-down recovery phrase means lost data, and that it must not be enabled together with the open selfsync plugin in the same vault.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin for Selfsync Cloud, a hosted version of selfsync.
problem: Obsidian users need to keep a vault in sync across devices without losing edits or letting the server read their notes.

relations.evidence: Obsidian plugin for Selfsync Cloud, a hosted version of selfsync.

summary: Hosted end-to-end-encrypted vault sync with automatic merges, conflict copies, deleted file recovery and file history.
